headline: Integrating Slack with v0: Streamlining Team Collaboration

sources.claim: The v0 bot for Slack lets anyone on your team contribute to production by mentioning `@v0` in a Slack channel. v0 reads the conversation thread for context, writes the code changes, creates a branch, and opens a pull request -- all without leaving Slack.
To target a specific repository or branch, use structured syntax: `@v0 [repo=acme/dashboard] Add a chart to the analytics page` or `@v0 [repo=acme/dashboard branch=feature-x] Fix the broken tooltip`.
Access channel settings by using the command `@v0 settings` to configure default repository and branch for the channel.
Once v0 opens a pull request, Vercel generates a preview deployment on every commit pushed to that branch, allowing your team to view and QA changes directly in the browser.
